scope: ESP32-S3 external DCache maintenance, exact official QEMU and native SDK primary-source contract; research evidence, not runtime qualification

decision.reason: The actual ESP32-S3 configured ISA does not expose the standard Xtensa cache maintenance instructions. Parent requested ROM/EXTMEM-only cutover after this finding; no unused generic hook or cache-instructions.patch is retained.

primary_sources.finding: XCHAL_DCACHE_SIZE=0, IS_WRITEBACK=0; the core-local Xtensa cache configuration is not the external EXTMEM cache.

Configured opcode metadata contains no DHI/DHWB/DHWBI or their index/.b forms (case-insensitive targeted search). Generic translator opcode rows do not prove an instruction is supported by this configured core.

Generic translate_dcache emits an otherwise unused byte-load. Generic opcode rows at2977-3018 map dhi/dhwb/dhwbi to that load, .b/index forms to no-op, and diwbui.p to address increment. These remain untouched.
Inspected actual CPUArchState, helper.h and op_helper.c for optional hook design; no change is necessary for the actual S3 ISA.
CPU reset updates selected state without memset(env); external cache reset remains machine/device owned, not an invented CPU helper.
DCache ways argument documents only CACHE_4WAYS_ASSOC works; MIN/MAX_DCACHE_WAYS are both4 at32-33. Shared enum exposes8ways but that is not evidence of a DCache8way mode.
Kconfig offers/defaults8ways, conflicting with the target-specific ROM contract. Actual pinned ROM ignores the ways argument.
DCache control bits4:3 line size, bit2 capacity, bit0 enable. No public DCache way bit1.
Sync ctrl bits0 invalidate,1 writeback,2 clean,3 done; SyncSize bits22:0 count cache blocks, not bytes.
Pins exported ROM jump-table addresses used below.

Public Cache_WriteBack_Addr treats size as bytes, zero bytes as success/no operation; handles unaligned edge lines through cache_writeback_items_freeze and aligned interior through rom_Cache_WriteBack_Addr.
Second pinned SDK agrees on only4 DCache ways; its register and core-ISA definitions also agree on block counts and core-local DCACHE_SIZE=0.

cache_mode.bit1: Not a validated DCache way selector; do not infer from ICache/shared enums or Kconfig.

rom_evidence.ways_argument: a3 is never read in complete body0x4004e2ec-0x4004e32f; bit1 never changed.

maintenance.size_unit: Configured external DCache blocks; byte span = items * configured line_bytes for nonzero item commands.

whole_cache_command.evidence: Cache_Invalidate_DCache_All export0x400016e0 literal target0x4004eac4: at0x4004eaca/0x4004eace sets both outgoing arguments0 then invokes invalidate-items dispatch slot+20 at0x4004ead0/0x4004ead2. Zero-sized item command must not be treated as an empty byte-range.

maintenance.zero_byte_api: Public patched Cache_WriteBack_Addr(addr,0) returns0 before emitting a command; distinguish API zero bytes from MMIO item-count0 whole-cache command.

Unsupported by actual S3 configured ISA; no invented block semantics or callback.

recommended_native_checks: ROM Cache_Set_DCache_Mode with both way arguments stays4ways; capacity/line mode writes are honored.
Ordinary Cache_WriteBack_Addr and Cache_Invalidate_Addr visibility through CPU cache and same-MMU DMA bypass, including unaligned patched SDK calls.
Cache_Invalidate_DCache_All uses zero item count and discards dirty lines without writing external storage.
